prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE standalone square transparent mineral-overlay master for a Minecraft Java 16x16 ore block.
Primary request: Tin Quartz QUIET independent variant 1: One short slanted dirty-gray quartz-cassiterite lode tip with a small offset step and two cassiterite cells clustered inside its fuller part, rather than along an outline. Geological identity: steep quartz-cassiterite fissure filling with greisen margins. This is an incidental partial window into the deposit, not a complete diagram on one block. Its dip, thickness pattern, interruption and structure must differ materially from retained variant 0 and sibling variant 2; never a rotation, mirror, recolor or relocated stamp.
Scene/backdrop: genuine RGBA transparency, alpha zero everywhere outside physical mineral cells; no host stone, deepslate, matte, checkerboard, panel or shadow.
Style/medium: coarse logical 16x16 pixel art authored at high resolution, with hard-edged square pixel clusters about one-sixteenth of the canvas width. Flat mostly opaque medium values; no subpixel marks, hairlines, antialiasing or smooth miniature painting.
Composition/framing: QUIET: about 6–14 visible logical cells, one compact connected cluster about 2 cells thick and 3–4 cells long; at least 5 visible and 4 in one 8-neighbor connected component. No edge contact required. Shape coherence and role hierarchy matter more than exact numeric fill. Keep most of the square transparent. The whole family identity emerges across varied tiled blocks; this single block shows only the local section described.
Materials/textures: medium dirty-gray quartz near stone, grouped slightly paler gray inset, sparse dark cassiterite cells; no white stripe or dark rail. Use two or three close mineral values grouped inside structures, enough to read at native16 against mid-gray host. No dark outline, pale highlight rail, extreme pigment, halo, carved or raised relief, or blanket alpha fade.
Constraints: exactly one 1:1 square PNG at least 1024x1024, untouched mineral-only source with true transparent alpha, one standalone texture, no text, label, watermark or frame.
Avoid: white lightning slash, centered crystal, uniform pale ribbon, black outlined lode; decorative speckles, centered object, complete whole-face seam or network, glow, gradients, haze, vignette, realism.
